event_summary: A small gray round object moves from left to right across a tabletop behind a stationary white open container.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a white, open-topped rectangular container standing upright near the center of a wooden tabletop. A partially visible dark object remains at the far left edge. After many frames, a small gray round object enters from the left side of the frame, travels rightward across the tabletop, becomes partly hidden by the white container as it passes behind or very near it from the camera viewpoint, reappears to the right of the container, continues rightward, and exits the visible area. The white container, tabletop, background, and dark left-edge object show no visible scene motion.

reasons: The white open container is fully visible on the tabletop.
The moving gray object is not yet visible in the first frame.
The surrounding tabletop and background are visible.
